reserve_semantics.interpretation: A2 FULL-feasible permits reserve shortfall in its original model. The policy retains the literal target demand as a stress scenario and rejects site/grid overflow. Achieved zero reserve cannot be substituted for full Q90 demand without changing the scenario and losing demand mass.

hard_failure_single_action_bound.scope: Single anonymous whole-gang delta evaluated against the fixed Q90 target scenario; not a global infeasibility certificate for a different multi-job queue model.

existing_API_recommendation.supported_without_source_edits: bounded_prototypes permits explicit source-defined time_slots, gpu_gangs, runtime_bounds; compile_sensitivity_policy accepts explicit anonymous prototypes. Broader frozen Planning-only coverage can increase continuous-reference eligible nominal conditions.
existing_API_recommendation.robust_feasibility_under_current_frozen_: NO: the final-slot whole-gang bound remains violated for any compatible single-action prototype, irrespective of time/gang/runtime coverage. The 309 evaluated candidates already show Q90 hard infeasibility.
existing_API_recommendation.do_not_promote: Do not classify May as OFFLINE_POLICY_OPTIMIZATION_VALIDATED, optimized Unknown action efficacy, or robust safety. Actual/Fresh-AC PASS verifies the executed fallback/known-control trace only; it does not create a feasible ranked Q90 policy.
existing_API_recommendation.scientific_followup_requires_new_explici: If a new experiment is authorized, define a capacity-respecting Q90 admission/queue/carryout response with the full unchanged forecast mass, hard per-job contracts and source-proven site/queue authority. Retest all original grid/resource constraints. This is not obtainable solely by changing current prototype enumeration or replacing target demand with achieved-zero reserve.
existing_API_recommendation.migration_authority_gap: All72 RUNNING templates explicitly retain MIGRATION_CAPABILITY_UNCONFIRMED; genuine source capability is required before migration candidates can be ranked.
existing_API_recommendation.current_actions: Keep current compiler-only status and QUEUE/STAY guarded fallbacks; preserve source/budget/Native/Actual receipts. No alternate compile/run was performed.

concise_recommendation_ko: May01 실정책은 144개 템플릿 모두 NO_FEASIBLE_ACTION이며 POLICY_COMPILER_ONLY로 유지해야 합니다. 102개는 익명 연속 Reference가 없고, 수치 평가 309개는 전부 Q90 Hard Constraint를 위반했습니다. 마지막 Slot의 수요 1009.8446 GPU는 설치 780 GPU보다 229.8446 GPU 많아 최대 단일 Gang 100 GPU를 완전히 제거해도 해결되지 않습니다. 현재 API로 익명 프로토타입 범위는 늘릴 수 있지만 같은 Q90 수요를 유지한 강건 정책은 만들 수 없습니다. Actual/Fresh AC PASS는 실행된 Guarded Fallback 및 Known 계획의 검증으로 별도 보고해야 합니다.
